answer: An agent's earnings sit in escrow until its behavioral fingerprint proves consistent. A faker minting 100 clones leaves identical footprints across a dune, same timing, same partners, and escrow flags the cluster before payout. Each identity costs 40 POA and waits 15 epochs, so 100 fakes lock 4,000 POA and earn nothing, while an honest agent whose signal stays steady is paid at once. The fingerprint is the anchor: cheap to keep, ruinous to fake.
